text:
incident-bot: Pager: model-fetch errors observed — huggingface artifact pulls returning 429s and triggering prolonged cold starts for some deployments. Auto-retries are backing off and a subset of customers reporting timeouts. Paging on-call for triage.

maria.ops: seeing a spike in 429s from hf.co for artifact pulls across us-west and eu-west. 10m rolling error rate ~12% for the downloader service.

ben.sre: on it. can you paste a sample error body from the downloader logs? wondering if Retry-After header present.

maria.ops: sure, grabbing logs now.

```
[downloader] ERROR: fetch artifact failed status=429 url=https://huggingface.co/models/redwood/ggml-13b/resolve/main/model.bin headers={"content-type":"application/json"} body={"error":"Too Many Requests"}
```

maria.ops: and the http response shows: `Retry-After: 60` on several responses.

jamie.prod: quick impact note: cold starts are mostly affecting Dedicated pools that try to fetch a model on first startup. Hosted caching mitigates for most tenants but a few with high churn hit the failure path.

ara.support: Are any paying customers currently degraded? support queue has two high-priority reports about generation timeouts from startups using on-demand Dedicated capacity.

ben.sre: ok. immediate mitigation options: 1) enable short-term local mirror fallback (S3 mirror we maintain) 2) relax aggressive downloader circuit-breaker to allow more parallel retries up to X times 3) patch runtime to prefer cached snapshot if available. pros/cons?

peng.partners: contacting Hugging Face via our partnership channel now — will share status. They reported a regional rate-limiting issue earlier but didn't give ETA.

maria.ops: running quick query to count failing pulls by region:

```
kubectl logs -l app=model-downloader -n inference | grep "status=429" | awk -F"region=" '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c
# output:  124 us-west
         87 eu-west
         6 ap-south
```

ben.sre: thanks. I'm going to enable the S3 fallback for us-west as a hotfix. will update the runbook.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: enable-s3-mirror-fallback v1 -> inference/downloader (canary: us-west)

jamie.prod: notify support and ops teams: set customer impact classification to "partial degraded performance" and advise that retries may increase latency.

ara.support: drafting message to affected customers: "We observed transient rate limiting from a third-party hosting provider (Hugging Face) affecting artifact downloads which may cause longer cold starts. We're applying a temporary mirror fallback and monitoring. No model data was exposed. We will follow up with timeline once provider resolves." any edits?

ben.sre: add note about mitigations applied and a suggested workaround (restart instances to pull from the mirror immediately).

ara.support: updated. posting to affected customers now.

peng.partners: HF responded: "We are experiencing elevated traffic and have applied a global rate-limiter. We are increasing capacity; monitoring ongoing. Retry-After headers are being returned. ETA unknown."

maria.ops: can we relax the downloader circuit-breaker now or will that just amplify retries and make HF throttle more?

ben.sre: leaving circuit-breaker but increasing concurrent retry budget + backoff jitter slightly. main goal is to avoid thundering herd. also implemented local jittered exponential backoff with max 8s between tries.

deploy-bot: Rollout success: enable-s3-mirror-fallback v1 -> inference/downloader (canary: us-west) - healthy

maria.ops: canary looks good: error rate in us-west fell from 14% -> 1.2% after mirror enabled. eu-west still seeing elevated 429s.

ben.sre: starting full rollout to eu-west but will throttle rollout steps.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: enable-s3-mirror-fallback v1 -> inference/downloader (eu-west rollout)

peng.partners: HF says they expect rate limits to relax in ~30-60m. I'll keep pinging and escalate to partner engineering if ETA slips.

jamie.prod: handoff timeline: ben wrapping initial mitigation and will hand to maria for monitoring; pinging next on-call at 1867890500 for 1hr stretch.

ben.sre: handing off to maria.ops — leaving a checklist: confirm mirror TTL, monitor 429s, ensure no increased cost alerts.

maria.ops: taking over. added a dashboard panel for downloader 429s and S3 fetch rates. also added alert: if 429 rate > 5% for 5m, page oncall.

ara.support: updating customer-facing incident note and adding internal severity: S2 (partial outage for cold starts). link to thread: <link suppressed>.

peng.partners: HF update: "Throttling reduced; global Retry-After trending lower; we continue to clear backlog."

maria.ops: eu-west rollout completed. final check: overall 429s down to 0.9% cluster-wide. cold-start complaints stopped from customers who restarted instances post-mirror rollout.

ben.sre: postmortem TODOs: - formalize mirror-fallback runbook - improve downloader metrics (per-model, per-region) - explore prefetch warmers for high-churn customers - partner SLA follow-up with HF.

jamie.prod: assigning postmortem to ben.sre, due in 3 working days. please include customer impact table and timeline of mitigations.

ara.support: recording impacted customer list and messages sent. will prepare a short blameless note for the comms channel.

incident-bot: Incident marked resolved for now — continue monitoring for 2h. If 429s resurge, reopen pager.

maria.ops: noted. leaving monitoring handover to peng.partners to continue HF contact.

peng.partners: will remain on HF channel until we're sure limits are stable. thanks everyone. :tada:"
